module.label: OBS output
module.description: Receives owned scene, source and audio changes.

flows.label: OBS connects or changes scene
flows.detail: Program scene reads use the guarded scene-list snapshot. If OBS has no valid program scene during a Studio Mode or collection change, callers wait rather than query the unsafe dedicated getter or guess a scene.

steps.label: Shared OBS connection
steps.detail: Serialize requests on one connection; use GetSceneList for current program reads and retain the SDK response fields. Missing program state stays unavailable without closing a healthy connection. Transport failures reconnect with shared backoff.
